name: sprintly
description: Strava for developers — track your coding sessions.

sprintly.autoPromptOnStartup.description: Ask whether to start a Sprintly session when VS Code opens.

sprintly.localHistoryEnabled.description: Keep aggregate session history locally in the current workspace. No network transfer is performed by this setting.

sprintly.historyRetention.description: Maximum number of aggregate session records kept locally.

sprintly.cloudSyncEnabled.description: Consent for the explicit Sync History action to prepare an aggregate-only website handoff. It never enables automatic uploads.

sprintly.websiteUrl.description: DevStrava website connection URL. The extension opens it only after an explicit handoff command and never puts session data in the URL.

sprintly.telemetry.trackCodingActivity.description: Record local coding activity counters and coding-style duration.

sprintly.telemetry.trackAgentUsage.description: Record local AI-agent prompt and token aggregates.

sprintly.telemetry.trackBuildFailures.description: Record local aggregate terminal failure and recovery metrics.

sprintly.telemetry.showAiTracking.description: Show AI-assisted metrics in the Sprintly Quick Panel.

sprintly.pricing.claudeCode.input.description: Estimated Claude Code input-token price in USD per million tokens.

sprintly.pricing.claudeCode.output.description: Estimated Claude Code output-token price in USD per million tokens.

sprintly.pricing.claudeCode.cacheRead.description: Estimated Claude Code cache-read token price in USD per million tokens.

sprintly.pricing.claudeCode.cacheCreate.description: Estimated Claude Code cache-creation token price in USD per million tokens.
